name: myaloca-system
observations: Hybrid desk booking and 3D workstation scheduling system

name: fastapi-async-backend
observations: FastAPI Async with SQLAlchemy 2.0 dual SQLite/PostgreSQL, JWT, QR Code, and Auto-Release scheduler

name: threejs-office-canvas
observations: Interactive 3D WebGL office floor plan with desk meshes, avatar presence, and photo badges

name: special-rooms-and-booking-policies
observations: Support for meeting rooms, phone/focus booths, role-based restrictions (gestor only), and duration limits (30min, 1h, 2h) with admin UI and booking modal enforcement

name: desk-deletion-governance
observations: Safe desk deletion with active booking guards, cascade of inactive records, and confirmation modal in admin panel

name: multi-company-building-floor-cruds
observations: Full corporate multi-tenant hierarchy with Company -> Building -> Floor/Zone -> Desk/Space models, full CRUD endpoints, referential deletion guards, and unified Facilities Management Hub in Vue frontend

name: user-profile-and-role-management
observations: Self-service profile and cargo/job_title editing via PUT /auth/me, DiceBear avatar selector and password change. Complete admin team hub in AdminUsersView.vue and /api/v1/users CRUD for role management (admin/gestor/colaborador), activation status, and CANNOT_DELETE_SELF guard

name: departments-crud-and-early-checkout
observations: Complete Department CRUD under /api/v1/departments with DEPARTMENT_HAS_USERS referral protection, dedicated Departments management tab in AdminUsersView.vue, dynamic selectors in AuthView.vue and user forms, and Early Checkout/Cancel support in MyBookingsView.vue and /bookings/{id}/checkout truncating end_time to now and freeing the desk immediately

name: admin-desk-reservation-release
observations: Allows administrators and gestores to release/cancel active bookings directly via POST /desks/{id}/release, resetting desk status to DISPONIVEL and truncating booking end_time to now. Integrated with Liberar Baia button in AdminDesksView.vue and direct click-to-release action panel in BookingModal.vue on the 3D office layout.

name: dynamic-floor-grid-equipment-and-drag-drop
observations: Configurable floor grid dimensions (grid_cols, grid_rows) per zone with dynamic CSS grid toolbar and full seed (Company, Building, 4 Depts, 3 floors); granular equipment settings (monitors_count 0-3, docking station, standing desk, extra_equipment) with Three.js multi-monitor meshes; 2D HTML5 drag and drop on floorplan; 3D raycast ground-plane drag and drop with 0.6m snap and in-map desk editor in BookingModal.

Automatic desk realignment and coordinates migration on zone grid resize in DeskService.update_zone preserving desks across dimensions; Voronoi nearest-cell matching in AdminDesksView.vue; diverse per-desk equipment profiles; physical standing desk elevation y=1.08m in Three.js; non-destructive 3D scene refresh without remounting or camera/floor reset.
